name: discover_agent_unknowns
title: Discover Agent Unknowns
description: Identify hidden assumptions and choose the next lightweight discovery artifact for an agent-assisted task

task_brief.description: User request or task summary to analyze for hidden assumptions and unknowns

phase.description: Current task phase. Defaults to before when omitted

context.description: Relevant repo, product, design, domain, or conversation context already available

user_expertise.description: What the user likely knows or does not know about the task area

constraints.description: Known time, scope, technical, policy, safety, compatibility, or acceptance constraints

discovered_facts.description: Sourced facts already verified from files, commands, docs, observed behavior, or user-provided context

unknowns_summary.description: Concise summary grouping known knowns, known unknowns, unknown knowns, and likely unknown unknowns

recommended_next_artifact.description: The next lowest-cost artifact that will reduce rework risk

questions.description: Only high-impact questions whose answers could change architecture, scope, acceptance, or review outcome

assumptions.description: Assumptions safe to proceed with unless contradicted later

blocked_by.description: Unknowns that currently prevent safe progress

stop_conditions.description: Future discoveries or threshold conditions that require pausing for user input

next_prompt.description: Ready-to-use instruction for the next agent step
